summary: Connect Group is a UAE-based business services provider offering company formation, HR and payroll outsourcing, visa and immigration processing, global workforce solutions (EOR/PEO), IT services, real estate, and legal services across the UAE, GCC, and international markets. The group operates through a network of specialist subsidiary brands, each focused on a specific service line or region.
details: Connect Group has set up over 15,000 businesses in the UAE and serves companies expanding into the UAE, Saudi Arabia, and other GCC/international markets. Core value proposition: one point of contact managing compliance, licensing, employment, and immigration across multiple government authorities (DET/DED, MOHRE, GDRFA, ICP, FTA, DHA).
blogNote: The blog archive spans 20+ paginated pages with roughly 10 posts per page. This file lists a representative recent sample; the full archive is browsable from the Insights page and its category filters above.
